question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

‘A person who remains unaffected by pleasure or pain’.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stoic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Stoic"** refers to a person who is indifferent to pleasure or pain, showing patience and endurance in the face of adversity. (संतोषी / अडिग)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite facing numerous challenges in life, she remained stoic and never let her emotions overwhelm her.
 

 
• **Explanation of the word: Stoic **(संतोषी / अडिग)
 
 
• A stoic person remains unaffected by emotional extremes, such as happiness or sadness. They maintain calm and resilience in all situations.
 
• **Example: **Even after losing the match, the athlete maintained a stoic expression and congratulated the opponent.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Stoic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Indifferent **(उदासीन): A person who does not show any interest or concern about something.
 
 
• **Example:** He was indifferent to the praise he received for his hard work.
 

 
• **Monk **(साधु): A person who lives a life of religious asceticism, often withdrawing from worldly pursuits.
 
 
• **Example:** The monk spent his days meditating in the mountains.
 

 
• **Sensualist **(भोगवादी): A person devoted to the pursuit of sensual pleasures and physical gratification.
 
 
• **Example:** The sensualist indulged in luxurious food and entertainment every day.
